action.description: plan checks the instance without changing anything. execute grants the access (or revokes it with revoke: true) and removes expired access policies for the principal.

instanceId.description: ID of the Linux EC2 instance.

principalArn.description: ARN of the IAM user or role that gets the access.

durationMinutes.description: How long the access lasts, at most the installation's limit. Granting again extends it and never shortens it.

revoke.description: Remove the principal's access to the instance instead of granting it.
